basis: Individually inspected half-open instruction spans, readable C and independent native routine-boundary comparisons. Canonical scalar records and prepared display settings only; scalar callees, scratch RAM and malformed BCD are not included implicitly.

ranges.scope: Scalar output preprocessing: surd conversion before header guard, marked rational rejection, metadata clearing and ordinary rational conversion status

Prepared display-precision rounding: Norm ten digits, Sci zero-to-ten precision, Fix fractional-part short circuit then multiply/integral-round/divide order; imaginary-first CMPLX wrapper and early native error return
